description: This Java source file defines the class 'Thing3ValuePredicateVisitor', a visitor implementation for evaluating criteria against partial 'Thing' objects with unknown fields, using Kleene logic for indeterminacy.

classes.name: Thing3ValuePredicateVisitor
classes.description: A visitor class implementing criteria evaluation logic with support for unknown fields using Kleene logic.

classes.name: Thing3ValuePredicateVisitor.Trilean
classes.description: An enum representing three-valued logic: TRUE, FALSE, and UNKNOWN, with logical operations.

classes.name: Thing3ValuePredicateVisitor.GetJsonPointer
classes.description: A visitor class to convert FieldExpression instances into JsonPointer objects.

methods.name: couldBeTrue
methods.description: Static method to evaluate if a criteria could be true given unknown fields and a partial thing.

methods.name: visitAnd
methods.description: Combines multiple Trilean functions with logical AND.

methods.name: visitAny
methods.description: Returns a function that always evaluates to TRUE.

methods.name: visitExists
methods.description: Evaluates existence of a field, returning UNKNOWN if the field is unknown.

methods.name: visitField
methods.description: Evaluates a field predicate, returning UNKNOWN if the field is unknown.

methods.name: isUnknownField
methods.description: Checks if a field expression refers to an unknown field.
